notes.title: V.1.2.5 Patch Notes
notes.notes:
Fixed wrong collisions with hitboxes and bouncing objects while playing Que Sera

Set a normal Gold Time for Petroleum Port: Lvl.2 (I have no idea why this happened in the first place)

An issue where finishing a level in Time Attack mode would result in a crash of the game should now be fixed.

Other various bug fixes



  EDIT:  V.1_2_51: Fireballs can make the player bounce again on certain objects

notes.title: V.1.2.3 Patch note
notes.notes:
And that's another bug fix update once again!


Fixed a bug where losing a race in a Bonus stage wouldn't save the Drainers collected in previous level correctly.
improved the behavior of the "balls" when they’re hit by the player’s attacks
Made sure the GLOVE/SHOE attack couldn't be used during a boss fight
Fixed a bug where players could get stuck after passing through an area with a low ceiling
Fixed a bug where getting a Bonus Key in World 7 - LVL.3 wouldn't give access to a Bonus Stage
Improved "Copain"'s behaviour

notes.title: V.1.2.2 Patch Note
notes.notes:
More bug fixes and QoL features!

Fixed a bug where the nuts during phase 1 of the Lethal Laboratory boss wouldn't go down if hit by a fireball

Fixed a bug where Globule and Que Sera would get stuck when using the Mega Punch Phial.

The big golden head in Eternal Envies Lvl.3 doesn't go down anymore when it reaches the end of its track (that was a bad idea anyway)

Changed the text that shows up in Petroleum Port Lvl.1 when specific conditions are met.

Added a message to warn players when the time to reach Que Sera's spirit has run out.

Various Bug, Performance & Visuals issues fixed.

A full patch note for V.1.2. and the following bug fix updates shall be released soon. Stay tuned!

notes.title: V.1.2.1 minor update: skin fix
notes.notes:
Small update because I'm dumb!

Fixed an error where all skins were unlocked by default.

notes.title: SHOES & MIRRORS UPDATE : AVAILABLE NOW
notes.notes:
It's finally happening! 



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42973984/fad9b41e25ba014074fbc6efb44f68e623566278.gif"]



The second major free content update of Decline's Drops is available right now!

It adds:

QUE SERA, the Third Puppet, is now playable! She's a slender, elegant yet fierce fighter! You'll need to find how to unlock her before you can test her moveset.

THE MIROIRS MENSONGERS, A brand new world which adds 4 stages and a unique boss. Unlocked once specific conditions are met.

BONUS STAGES: Race to the finish in this top down racer! Winning the race shall unlock

COLOR ALTS : There are now many alt. colors available for Globule AND Que Sera! I had a lot of fun making these!



I hope you'll enjoy all this brand new content. It was a lot of work, but I'm happy this is finally done and it's always a pleasure to bring more stuff to the world of Decline's Drops.



More free content is still coming though, so stay tuned for more news!



Oh by the way: Did you watch the brand new Decline's Drops Direct?



And of course, to celebrate, Decline's Drops is 30% off for two weeks starting now!



Thanks for reading, thanks for playing!



-Drazglb.

notes.title: V.1.1.6 Update : QoL Improvements and Bug Fixes!
notes.notes:
Hello Everyone!

A new update has just been released for Decline's Drops! At first, I planned to wait for the next major content update before releasing a new patch, but some bugs were reported that required immediate attention, mainly:  

1. Custom commands were not properly configured and could trap the player in the options menu.  
2. An item (the Shiny Shiny Phial) in Serge's shop could not be unlocked, preventing players from achieving 100% completion.  

These frustrating bugs have now been fixed, so you should be able to enjoy the game as intended without any issues! Game performance has also been improved, especially in Time Trial mode.  

In any case, here is the full Patch Notes:  

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42973984/f5be8bd9e55bc783f5a086562c9e948479b855f3.png

As for the next major content update, progress is going well, although I can't provide a precise release date yet. Don't forget to join the game's Discord if you want to stay updated on upcoming updates!  

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42973984/04574bd9f924e985565eb8f287ebe63bab482f3b.gif

Thanks for reading, and see you soon!


-Drazglb

notes.title: Patch Notes for V.1.1.4

notes.title: DECLINE'S DROPS: FIRST MAJOR UPDATE IS OUT
notes.notes:
IT'S UPDATE TIME BOYS

The first major update of Decline's Drops is finally here! As promised, it brings the Boss Rush Mode, Time-Attack with GHOSTS, your own but also the Dev Ghosts - that means those are my ghosts. That's me playing. I'm quite bad at my own game, you'll see. But if you beat all of them, you'll get a special reward, isn't that great? Spoiler alert: it's another new Mode! There's also another bonus you get for beating the Boss Rush Mode, in fact, there are new bonuses everywhere! You'll also get two new objects available at Serge's Shop, unlockable once specific requirements are fulfilled, and also many quality of life improvements, bug fixes, new options, new buttons!
I also made sure to include lots of new option regarding the smash attacks, so for example you can now disable the Smash attacks by pressing a direction and the normal attack button, or use the right stick to launch them. 
In any case, please take a look at the full Patch Notes to see what's new!

To celebrate and also as part of the Steam Winter Sales, Decline's Drops is 30% off until January 2nd!

It was a ton of fun making this new update and I hope you will enjoy the new content. But, as you probably now, this is not over yet, I still have a looot more to bring to the world of Decline's Drops, and the next update will be quite big, so it will probably take more time to be done.

In the meantime, enjoy the new update, and please, please leave a review if you haven't already, it helps a ton!

Thank you so much for reading and playing Decline's Drops!

-Drazglb.

notes.title: Oh look it's an update! + OFFICIAL RELEASE DATE
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42973984/75255ca6640bf0b6f90707a9b9e7b112095f3e91.gif

Wow, it's actually been a while this Steam page is up, and still no news! I think it's time to fix that.

And let's start right away with saying the following:
Decline's Drops will come to PC this October 10th!

It's been a long, long road, and it's quite incredible to finally reach the finish line. I hope you will enjoy what we've been working on for all these years (5 years, wow, that's a lot.), I'm so excited!

In the meantime, I hope you enjoy the Demo of Decline's Drops! Don't forget to send your feedback in the discussions, but you can also join our Discord to follow the progress of the game!

Also please follow us on social medias if you don't already, it helps a ton!

Thank you all for your feedback and I will fix some bugs mentioned as soon as possible!

Thanks for reading!

-Drazglb.
